call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: AI Workload Monitoring Monetization & Customer Usage Trajectory
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Olivier, you noted that 35% YoY revenue growth was fueled in part by digital operations and AI workloads. Can you quantify the direct contribution from AI-native customers and how traditional enterprises are using Datadog to monitor their LLMs?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Olivier Pomel (CEO) replied: 'AI is rapidly becoming a pervasive driver across our platform. AI-native customers represent over 6% of our ARR and are growing at triple-digit rates. But more importantly, traditional enterprises are now deploying LLM models into production, and they require Datadog for tracing, latency debugging, and token cost governance. We see AI accelerating cloud data consumption across all three pillars.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: David, GAAP gross margin expanded to 80.19% and Non-GAAP was above 82%. What drove the efficiency in cloud hosting costs, and is this 80%+ level sustainable into 2027?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: David Obstler (CFO) responded: 'Our gross margin performance reflects ongoing structural engineering optimizations across our data processing pipeline. We've optimized our multi-cloud architecture and tiering of log data. While we continue to reinvest in new AI capabilities, we feel very comfortable with gross margins remaining in the low-to-mid 80s range.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Olivier, with 4,860 customers now over $100K ARR, how much of the growth is coming from customers consolidating disjointed point solutions into the Datadog platform?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Olivier Pomel explained: 'Consolidation is our primary growth engine. CIOs are actively eliminating separate vendors for APM, infrastructure, logs, and cloud security. Over 49% of our customers now use four or more products, and our security products continue to show the fastest adoption curves in our history. The Datadog unified data model is an unbeatable value proposition.'
